text:
I'll pause CI on this machine for 6 hours, since I don't know when you'll stop gaming. Running jobs finish first, and nothing new starts until it ends.

```sh
sudo tentmaker pause --for 6h gaming --json
tentmaker budget --json
```

The first command pauses the device. The second confirms the pause is in effect.

To resume early:

```sh
sudo tentmaker resume --json
```

Your environment reports macOS (darwin), but you described a Linux desktop. The commands are the same on either OS, so I'll run them as written. Tell me if you wanted a different duration.
